instruction: Reduce the person to one-third height, feet fixed at the same ground location.
target: The solitary person on the foreground rock
repair_prompt: An empty rocky ledge in front of distant forest and a mountain slope. Continue the surrounding collage textures naturally. No people, no person, no silhouette.
visual_checks: Was the entire original person removed, without leaving a ghost or a second person?
Does the smaller person stand naturally on the same rock?
Do the repaired mountain, forest and rock textures join naturally at the mask boundary?
Does the mountain feel larger and more overwhelming?
author: Codex: manually traced approximate person mask; requires visual review
